title: Relevance

scenes.title: Two hundred ideas by breakfast
scenes.viewerPurpose: More hypotheses do not expand the time to judge them. Develops relevance as a contextual selection problem under generative abundance, where purpose and situation determine what matters.

cues.text: By breakfast, a laboratory has two hundred new hypotheses and no more time to judge them.

cues.text: Relevance shifts the AI question from producing more ideas to deciding which deserve our limited attention.
